patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Crisp and Tidio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Crisp and Tidio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Crisp only if your buying job matches “Omnichannel messaging with Hugo AI — Free (2 seats); Mini $45; Essentials $95; Plus $295/w” rather than Tidio's shape. Choose Tidio only if your buying job matches “Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Growth from $” rather than Crisp's shape. Workflow advantage: Crisp leans omnichannel-support; Tidio leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Crisp and Tidio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Crisp is Omnichannel messaging with Hugo AI — Free (2 seats); Mini $45; Essentials $95; Plus $295/workspace/mo. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; Tidio is Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Growth from $49.17. Primary live-chat; CS secondary..
- Workflow coverage skew: Crisp-leaning omnichannel-support vs Tidio-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Crisp — Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments; Tidio — Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers.

Limitations — Crisp: Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments; Extra seats beyond included allotment cost $10/seat/mo on paid plans; Tidio: Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers; Not a full helpdesk/ITSM — thin ticketing vs Freshdesk.

Poor-fit cases: Crisp is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments · Tidio is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Conversation-cap pricing — high traffic sites need Growth+ tiers · Avoid Crisp if you actually need Tidio's motion (Live chat and AI messaging — Starter $24.17/mo annual (100 billable convos); Gro)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
